A '''diagnostics sensor''' was a piece of medical technology included in [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] [[medkit]]. The [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] was capable of diagnosing diseases, assessing health, and other medical functions.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
